scripts.android:check: npx --no-install elastic-otel-react-native setup-android && git diff --exit-code -- android
scripts.format:check: prettier --check App.tsx __tests__/App.test.tsx README.md package.json app.json .eslintrc.js jest.config.js metro.config.js "scripts/**/*.md" "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.ios:build: mkdir -p build/tmp && GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=all TMPDIR="$PWD/build/tmp" xcodebuild -workspace ios/ReactNativeDemoApp.xcworkspace -scheme ReactNativeDemoApp -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.ios:check: npx --no-install elastic-otel-react-native setup-ios && npm run ios:autolink:check && npm run ios:format:check && mkdir -p build/tmp && cd ios && TMPDIR="../build/tmp" pod install --deployment
scripts.ios:install: npx --no-install elastic-otel-react-native setup-ios && mkdir -p build/tmp && cd ios && TMPDIR="../build/tmp" pod install
scripts.ios:run: mkdir -p build/tmp && GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=all TMPDIR="$PWD/build/tmp" react-native run-ios
